items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: I worked with Pete for a long time... he played most of that with that tuxedo band... and now... he called it the Creole Serenators... that's his own band

ctx.x: Yes, indeed, he could play. He looked like nothing wouldn't happen to him, but he just like that. Yes, sir.
Now, the other day you were playing with Peter Bocard there. Is that the first time you worked with Peter?

No, no, I worked with Pete for a long time. He played, I played practically, just like I said, Pete would play from different bands, with one band from another, see, but he played, he played most of that with that tuxedo band, you know, and the Eureka, he played with all them bands, different bands, and now, because he just, he just made this band up, this band, what he's got now, he called it the Creole Serenators. Oh yeah, that's the late years. Yeah, that's the late years, the Creole Serenators, you see, and…
